externalValuesNotes.executionGraphOpAndProbeStages: Execution-graph op ids and probe stage names. Most mirror Hugging Face module names (q_proj, gate_proj) and the rest share that namespace; they are bound into published manifests, executionGraphHash digests of capsules and program bundles, and recorded operator-attribution receipts, so they keep their spelling.

legacyLiteralAllowedFilesNotes: quantization-info and kv_quantize rules predate this list; the trainer handoff schema accepts the Gamma spelling huggingface_safetensors on read, and the nativekd2 handoff is a digest-bound Gamma input kept byte-for-byte. The trainer-artifact bridge, parity-evidence and translation-competition schemas list each converted value in both spellings because Doppler reads descriptors written before 0.2.0. The translation competition policy is digest-bound by the recorded 2026-07-13 receipt. Benchmark fixtures and the release matrix are recorded results written before 0.2.0. Conversion configs are inputs; the converter reads their legacy spellings. The autograd tape op id cross_entropy (with its cross_entropy_backward kernel) is an op id that shares the legacy spelling of the training objective; op ids keep their spelling.
